title: DEEPCHART: How Far are LLMs from Faithful Data-Science Chart Generation?
abstract: arXiv:2608.26757v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Faithful chart generation in real-world data-science workflows requires grounding visualizations in scattered evidence, computing chart-ready quantities, and rendering them accurately. Modern LLMs can produce visually plausible, instruction-compliant charts, yet data-level hallucinations remain difficult to detect in long, noisy, and multimodal contexts. To measure this gap, we introduce DEEPCHART, an expert-annotated benchmark of 1,482 task-conditioned chart-generation instances drawn from real-world scientific papers, financial filings, and ecosystem reports. DEEPCHART formulates chart generation as an Extract--Reason--Visualize pipeline and evaluates source-data extraction, derived-data reasoning, and chart rendering stage by stage. Experiments with state-of-the-art models show that visually plausible charts often conceal data-level hallucinations, with extraction and reasoning errors common in realistic long and multimodal settings.

translated_title: DEEPCHART：大型语言模型在忠实数据科学图表生成方面还有多远？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26757v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在真实世界的数据科学工作流程中，忠实的图表生成需要基于分散的证据进行可视化，计算图表就绪的数据，并准确渲染它们。现代大型语言模型可以生成视觉上合理、符合指令的图表，但在长、嘈杂和多模态上下文中，数据层面的幻觉仍然难以检测。为了衡量这一差距，我们引入了DEEPCHART，一个由专家标注的基准，包含1,482个任务条件下的图表生成实例，这些实例来自真实世界的科学论文、财务申报和生态系统报告。DEEPCHART将图表生成构建为“提取-推理-可视化”流程，并分阶段评估源数据提取、派生数据推理和图表渲染。与最先进模型的实验表明，视觉上合理的图表往往掩盖数据层面的幻觉，在现实的长和多模态设置中，提取和推理错误很常见。
tldr: DEEPCHART基准揭示了大型语言模型在生成视觉上合理但数据上不忠实的图表时，提取和推理错误在真实复杂场景中普遍存在。
en_tdlr: DEEPCHART benchmark reveals that large language models often produce visually plausible yet data-unfaithful charts, with extraction and reasoning errors being common in realistic complex scenarios.
